result.summary: The page layout is mostly intact, with one notable content clipping issue in the 'Trattoria Piccolo' card title, which is not part of the excluded horizontal scroll case since it's a vertical section title clipped by fixed width.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccolo' is truncated ('Piccol') within its card in the 'Fastest near you' section, even though this card is part of a horizontally scrollable row but appears to be cut off mid-word rather than by the screen edge cleanly.
issues.suggestion: Ensure text truncation uses ellipsis styling or allow enough card width so names aren't cut off mid-word.
